title: feat(telemetry): Add alternatives coverage metrics and alert
summary: The plan of this case is the hand-written plan of #3173, with group 5 as a `manifest` group: it writes the promtool cases of the alert first, and its verify runs them. It is the `manifest` case of the golden set (#5205): the plan reader reads its groups back with their kinds.
notes: Group 5 changes `tests/fixtures/prometheus_rules/roadmap_service_activity_tests.yaml`, so its kind is `manifest`: its promtool cases come first, and its verify runs them. The twin has the kind `other`.

The plan has a `security` text, because it changes manifests under `k8s/`, and the scenario 'The queries of the three panels' names the count of the selector with no code span, so that the gates `paths` and `content` accept the plan. The twin has neither edit.
Group 7 runs `uv run devops docs generate`, because #5198 deleted the option `--sync-readme` that the twin names.
The scores are set by hand. No review scored this plan.
